question: ABCD is a trapezium in which BC ∥ AD and AC = CD. If ∠ABC = 69° and ∠BAC = 23° , then what is the measure of ∠ACD (in degree) .?
solution:
**Calculation:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6df85bb678d4030b9f025ad2b98108a24cc1b9378ff5943eebe2ebcbe93d04f.png] **

In Δ ABC:

∠ACB = 180° - (∠ABC + ∠BAC) = 180° - (69° + 23°) = 180° - 92° = 88°

Since AD ∥ BC,

So, ∠ACB = ∠CAD = 88°

Now, In Δ ACD:

AC = CD, So ∠CAD = ∠ADC

i.e. ∠CAD = ∠ADC = 88°

So, ∠ACD = 180 - (∠CAD + ∠ADC)

⇒ 180° - (88° + 88°) = 180° - 176° = 4°

**Hence, the measure of ∠ACD is 4 degrees.**
